description:
Fetch messages from a group conversation by ID, newest first.

    The caller must be a member of the group. Returns ``title``,
    ``member_count``, and ``messages[]`` with each message's sender,
    body, attachments, reply-to, and timestamps.

    ``count`` is how many messages this response holds; ``has_more`` is
    true when the group has older messages than ``limit`` allowed.
    ``total`` is DEPRECATED: it is the same number as ``count``, the page
    length, NOT the number of messages in the group. Requires
    authentication.
name: colony_get_group_conversation
